name: WhatsApp Connector
description: WhatsApp connector for Home Assistant (QR, send, inbound webhook). Uses a WhatsApp-compatible technology layer; service availability depends on upstream support. The developer will attempt compatibility updates if upstream changes. Use at your own risk.

options.connection_help: Open Web UI to view link status and use Reconnect.
options.script_usage_help: Use script.whatsapp_send with target and message. Title is optional and ignored for delivery.

changelog.1.3.0: Added built-in licensing workflow (7-day trial, activate/release, buy-link) and enforcement for send/inbound features.
changelog.1.2.3: Moved to add-on-only UX, added config help text for link/reconnect and script usage, and removed dependency on custom dashboard.
changelog.1.2.2: Stability and startup fixes, plus updated panel naming.
changelog.1.2.1: Added reconnect control, send/receive logs with retention, and CSV export.
changelog.1.2.0: Improved connection handling and configuration controls.
